7450d7f17a80fa9e.description: About the role Green Earth is a premium laundry and leather care brand in Saudi Arabia, serving customers in-store and through our pickup & delivery service. As a Customer Service Advisor, you are the face of Green Earth at the counter. Receiving and returning orders is part of the job, but the real work is advising. That includes understanding what each customer needs, recommending the right care for every item, explaining the options clearly, and handling difficult situations confidently within company policy. Your mission is to turn first-time visitors into loyal, regular customers. Key responsibilities 1. Service advisory and consultative selling • Inspect items with the customer at drop-off then recommend the right service. • Explain clearly the difference between services, and why prices differ. • Recommend add-ons and premium services where applicable. • Promote the Green Earth app and our pickup & delivery service. • Work towards monthly targets for add-on sales, average ticket value and app / delivery sign-ups. 2. Customer communication and expectation setting • Set the right expectations at drop-off such as turnaround time and realistic outcomes. • Build relationships with regular and VIP customers and cater to individual requests. • Communicate professionally and warmly in Arabic and English. 3. Handling scenarios within company policy and GE norms • Resolve common counter situations calmly and in line with company policy. • Know your own authority limits and when to escalate to the superiors. 4. Reception and cashier • Register orders accurately in the POS. • Hand over completed orders and check items with the customer at collection. • Take payments, maintain the cash drawer and complete daily closing. • Follow daily reception SOPs and keep the counter clean, organised and presentable. Who we are looking for Must have • 2+ years in a customer-facing role that involved advising or selling, * premium retail or hotel front desk. • Fluent Arabic and good spoken English. • Confident and able to handle objections and explain value, not just price. • Comfortable with POS systems, computers and cash handling. • Well presented, punctual and reliable. Nice to have • Knowledge of fabrics, garment care or leather. • Experience serving premium or VIP clientele. Training we provide New advisors receive structured onboarding covering: • Dry cleaning fundamentals: what garments can and cannot be cleaned, and why. • Leather services: what can and cannot be serviced and expected outcomes. • Green Earth services, add-ons, pricing and the app / pickup & delivery offering. • POS software in depth. • Daily reception SOPs, company policies, escalation limits and GE service standards. Working conditions • Working hours: 9 hours per day, including a 1-hour break. • Working days: Saturday to Thursday (Friday off). • Location: Jeddah (Al Zahra) or Riyadh (Al Aqiq). • Salary: SAR 6,000 per month during the probation period; SAR 7,000 per month after successful completion of probation. • Incentive: based on achieving targets.

74dc982a29abc551.description: Perform welding, fabrication, and metalworking activities within Oil & Gas and petrochemical facilities. Carry out welding operations in accordance with approved procedures, technical specifications, and applicable industry standards. Perform metal cutting, fitting, assembly, and fabrication of mechanical and structural components. Support pipe fitting, welding, and installation of piping systems and associated mechanical equipment. Inspect welded joints and fabricated components to ensure compliance with quality and safety requirements. Interpret engineering drawings, welding specifications, and fabrication instructions. Support rigging and lifting operations during mechanical installation and fabrication activities. Coordinate with scaffolding and rigging teams to ensure safe access and handling of materials. Perform welding and fabrication activities in accordance with applicable ANSI/ASME and AWS standards. Identify welding defects, fabrication issues, and equipment problems and implement corrective actions. Maintain welding tools, fabrication equipment, and work areas in safe operating condition. Follow OSHA safety requirements and applicable workplace safety procedures. Prepare work reports and maintain documentation related to welding, fabrication, and inspection activities. - Education: Local and Expat Candidates with a Degree: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a Bachelor's degree in a Technical, Trade, or Vocational field specializing in Mechanical Engineering or Mechanical Technology. Expat Candidates Without a Degree: High School Certificate or Vocational School Diploma in Mechanical Technology. - Experience: Candidates with a Degree: Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas sector. Candidates Without a Degree: Minimum 11 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas sector. - English Language Proficiency: Minimum IELTS score of 6.0 or equivalent TOEFL scores: Internet-Based (iBT): 60 Paper-Based (PBT): 498 Computer-Based (CBT): 171 - Preferred Technical Skills & Experience: Experience in Oil & Gas and petrochemical environments. Strong knowledge of welding, fabrication, and metalworking activities. Experience in pipe fitting and mechanical fabrication. Familiarity with scaffolding and rigging operations. Ability to interpret welding procedures, fabrication drawings, and technical specifications. Knowledge of ANSI/ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section IX. Familiarity with AWS D1.1 and applicable SAEP standards (S01, S12, S07). Understanding of welding inspection requirements and quality control procedures. Knowledge of industrial safety standards and OSHA requirements. Preferred Certifications: OSHA Safety Certification. Welder Qualification Test Record (WQTR) in accordance with ANSI/ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section IX. Relevant welding qualification or certification aligned with AWS D1.1 or applicable SAEP requirements.

74d096fd5bfad345.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سلوكيرا عن موظف خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم والمساعدة للعملاء عبر قنوات التواصل المتنوعة، مع التركيز على معالجة الاستفسارات والشكاوى بكفاءة واحترافية. يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في تحسين تجربة العملاء ورفع مستوى رضاهم، مما ينعكس إيجاباً على كفاءة الأداء العام للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم والمساعدة المباشرة للعملاء عبر مختلف قنوات الاتصال. الرد على استفسارات العملاء بوضوح ودقة. استقبال الشكاوى والملاحظات من العملاء والعمل على معالجتها بفعالية. متابعة طلبات العملاء وتزويدهم بالمعلومات اللازمة أولاً بأول. العمل على تحسين سير العمل ورفع مستوى رضا العملاء. المساهمة في زيادة كفاءة الأداء العام لقسم خدمة العملاء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو دور مشابه. القدرة على التعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى العملاء بمهنية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص في خدمة العملاء، وستتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى مستويات رضا العملاء. التقديم إذا كنت ترى في نفسك المؤهلات والخبرة المناسبة لهذا الدور، ندعوك للتقديم والانضمام إلى فريق سلوكيرا في الرياض.

7402fc1b8e05afed.description: About the Role Tecnimont is seeking a Commissioning Supervisor (Operations) for a contract position in Jubail, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This role involves executing pre-commissioning and commissioning activities for entire plant units, ensuring compliance with quality standards, health, environmental, and safety regulations, and adhering to established procedures. Key Responsibilities Develop detailed pre-commissioning procedures for machinery and packages, including functional test procedures, as per Commissioning Machinery Superintendent instructions. Conduct field checks of DAC and prepare relevant Commissioning punch lists, following CME instructions. Expedite the closure of pending Punch List Items in accordance with Commissioning Superintendent (COT) priorities. Monitor and ensure all activities are carried out according to established procedures and requirements. Ensure all safety rules are enforced and followed in the field. Supervise the work of vendor specialists and ensure their efficient utilization. Organize and manage field operations for the assigned subcontractor team, controlling their work and the implementation of Plant Safety procedures during emergencies. Support vendor specialists in job execution and coordinate their actions with Commissioning supervisors. Maintain records of all performed activities in the logbook. Produce certificates, duly signed by involved parties, and hand them over to the certification engineer (QA/QC). Responsible for ongoing planned and corrective maintenance on Plant Units already in operation, in accordance with Commissioning Superintendent (COT) and Commissioning Machinery Superintendent (CMT) priorities. May be designated by the site manager as an authorized person to receive or issue a Permit to Work according to project procedures. Qualifications and Experience Education: University Degree or equivalent Diploma in Engineering. Experience: 8 years of relevant field experience in Commissioning Operations. Relevant experience in the construction or modernization of oil & gas, industrial sector, or EPC projects involving large refinery plants. Proven experience in a similar role on at least three projects of comparable size. Experience working on the Contractor side is required. Compensation An excellent salary package with benefits will be offered for this contract position.

74092b1873f30c9a.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is a CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) company focused on business communication solutions. The team comprises over 400 individuals dedicated to serving more than 5000 customer-centric companies. Unifonic fosters a collaborative work environment that encourages creativity and new ideas. The company has been recognized as a Great Place to Work®. The Role: Product Manager - Data & Insights As a Product Manager, Data & Insights at Unifonic, you will lead the development of both customer-facing dashboards and internal reporting systems. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, requires 5-10 years of experience and sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and analytics. You will be responsible for delivering intuitive, reliable, and scalable reporting experiences for external users and internal stakeholders. The position involves owning the end-to-end product lifecycle for reporting capabilities, from customer research and data modeling to delivery, governance, and continuous improvement. You will also champion and lead data compliance initiatives across all Unifonic products. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the roadmap for customer-facing analytics, reporting portals, and internal reporting infrastructure. Align reporting solutions with business goals and customer needs, prioritizing initiatives based on impact and value. Act as an advisor for other Product teams in data strategy and design. Collect business and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. Develop detailed feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contracts for reporting systems. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined reporting needs and KPIs. Partner with data engineers to co-develop data models and data marts in data warehouses (*, Snowflake, Qlik, Vertica). Influence architectural decisions related to ETL/ELT processes and dimensional modeling. Own and enforce data governance standards, including data definitions, taxonomy, lineage, and version control. Define processes for data quality verification and anomaly detection in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams. Own the product experience and lifecycle for reporting and BI platforms (*, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Mode). Define self-service analytics capabilities for internal teams and create feedback loops for continuous improvement. Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams, translating business needs into technical requirements and vice versa. Present product updates, reporting insights, and metrics to executives and cross-functional teams. Qualifications and Requirements 5+ years of experience in product management, data, analytics, or reporting platforms, with a focus on data-driven products. Proven experience delivering customer-facing reporting products, dashboards, and internal analytics solutions. Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and compliance frameworks, including GDPR and PDPL. Experience working cross-functionally with data engineers, analysts, product teams, UX, and business stakeholders. Hands-on experience with data warehouses such as ClickHouse, Vertica, or Snowflake, and BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Sigma. Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including fact and dimension tables and star schemas. Familiarity with ELT pipelines, dbt, and data orchestration tools is beneficial. Understanding of data quality, data integrity, scalability, and performance considerations for reporting solutions. Ability to define business KPIs and translate business and reporting needs into clear data and product requirements. Experience contributing to data governance, data integrity, and compliance initiatives. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field. AI Proficiency and Character Traits AI Proficiency (L4 - Proficient): Applies AI across product discovery, specification, prototyping, and stakeholder communication. Uses AI to speed up research, specs, and prototyping, while personally owning the accuracy of every output. Experience with Claude and Lovable is preferred. Analytical Thinking and Problem-Solving: Approaches problems clearly, uses data, and finds solutions. Ownership and Accountability: Takes responsibility and follows projects through to completion. Communication and Collaboration: Explains ideas clearly, listens to others across teams, and works well with colleagues to support team goals. Adaptability and Learning: Adjusts to change and continuously acquires new skills or tools. Quality and Attention to Detail: Executes work carefully and strives for continuous improvement. Work Environment The Engineering team at Unifonic is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. This role involves close collaboration with other departments to meet customer needs. Unifonic fosters a fun and collaborative environment, encouraging creativity and new ideas. As shareholders, employees are integral to the company's growth.

7459dae44a38a63b.description: نبحث عن أخصائي مبيعات متحمس وطموح للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تطوير استراتيجيات المبيعات، وإدارة علاقات العملاء، وتحقيق الأهداف المحددة. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة وشغفاً بمجال المبيعات، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام والمسؤوليات: استقبال العملاء والترحيب بهم وتقديم خدمة مميزة واحترافية. التعرف على احتياجات العملاء ورغباتهم وتقديم المنتجات المناسبة لهم. عرض المنتجات وشرح مواصفاتها ومميزاتها وأسعارها واستخداماتها. تقديم الاستشارات والاقتراحات للعملاء لمساعدتهم في اتخاذ قرار الشراء. تنفيذ عمليات البيع وإصدار الفواتير وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. استقطاب عملاء جدد وبناء علاقات تجارية مستمرة مع العملاء الحاليين. متابعة العملاء المحتملين والتواصل معهم لإتمام عمليات البيع. تقديم العروض البيعية والتعريف بالعروض والخصومات المعتمدة. تحقيق الأهداف والمستهدفات البيعية المحددة من الإدارة. متابعة طلبات العملاء والتنسيق مع الفروع والمستودعات لتوفير المنتجات. متابعة توفر المنتجات وإبلاغ المسؤول عن النواقص والاحتياجات. التعامل مع استفسارات العملاء وملاحظاتهم ومعالجة المشكلات المتعلقة بالمبيعات. ترتيب المنتجات وتنظيمها والمحافظة على نظافة وجاهزية المعرض. متابعة حركة المبيعات وتقديم التقارير والملحوظات للإدارة المختصة. الالتزام بسياسات الشركة وإجراءات البيع والأسعار والعروض المعتمدة. التعاون مع فريق العمل وتنفيذ المهام الأخرى ذات الصلة وفق توجيهات المدير المباشر.

74370a2b8d5c6664.description: About the Role Shanahan Engineering is seeking a Commissioning Specialist Electrical to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern Province. This contract position involves supporting SATORP Project Management during the pre-commissioning, commissioning, and start-up phases. The specialist will act on the company side, ensuring all electrical pre-commissioning and commissioning activities are prepared and executed safely and according to the planned schedule, adhering to the OPERCOM® methodology. Key Responsibilities Review and approve Operations and Maintenance training programs, commissioning, testing, and safety procedures. Review and approve reliability strategies, including spare parts, redundancy, RBI programs, and turnaround planning. Coordinate activities between company and project teams. Represent the company during commissioning, start-up, and performance testing. Attend daily meetings, reporting progress and key issues. Review and witness the Lenders’ Reliability Test (LRT) plan and execution. Main Accountabilities Prioritize Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) for all electrical personnel. Coordinate and approve the quality and completeness of deliverables. Assist Commissioning Unit leaders in witnessing and monitoring pre-commissioning and commissioning activities. Review pre-commissioning dossiers and attached preliminary checks. Supervise the management and operation of switchgear and switchboard manipulations performed by Contractors after energization of high voltage networks within the electrical substation for commissioning tests, in collaboration with the Proponent Electrical team. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess a minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. The position requires strong coordination skills to manage various project entities, including the Interface department, Integration team, and Project Services. Contract Details This is a 12-month renewable contract position. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

74c1361e81dd5453.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Development to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves implementing various development tasks within the Qiddiya City-Wide development, focusing on the integration of roads, transport, utilities, security, hydrology, environment, and landscape. The Director will ensure alignment with Qiddiya city and local regulatory frameworks, collaborating with cross-disciplinary teams and managing stakeholder relationships. Key Responsibilities Oversee the process, progress, budget, and program of development from planning to project handover, ensuring regional entity requirements are incorporated. Comprehend Qiddiya development processes, governance procedures, and procurement policies to support daily activities. Extract key development parameters from strategy briefs, local laws, environmental constraints, and future-proofing requirements. Translate utilities operators' and local authorities' requirements into standard development briefs. Prepare stage gate presentations and coordinate with internal stakeholders for consensus and alignment. Prepare governance approval papers for various levels and coordinate BoD level slides. Prepare procurement strategies in coordination with shared services units to meet development objectives and budgets. Evaluate land use proposals and changes to ensure alignment with Qiddiya City and District policies. Conduct impact assessments for proposed land use planning changes. Manage interfaces, updates, and refinements to the framework plan and designs. Stakeholder Coordination and Project Planning Act as a liaison between the master developer, architects, engineers, government ministries, agencies, and community stakeholders. Coordinate regulatory approvals to ensure seamless integration with the development build program. Maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including governmental agencies and service providers. Evaluate proposed infrastructure assets, network deployment plans, and public realm requirements. Assess proposed construction sequencing and provide input into the program and spatial planning. Provide input into procurement packaging, budget, and cost estimation, ensuring delivery within approved parameters. Participate in drafting project agreements and review project designs for compliance with Qiddiya’s requirements. Identify risks and propose mitigation plans for project delivery and execution. Propose project execution organization charts and work with development leads on asset façade and theme application. Project Team Interface and Process Management Provide support and direction to project teams, ensuring effective coordination and communication. Review project plans, including scope, schedules, budgets, and risk management strategies. Monitor project progress, providing regular updates to senior management and stakeholders. Conduct site inspections and meetings to ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations. Foster innovation and continuous improvement within project teams. Manage disputes, issues, and conflicts, ensuring effective resolution. Review and comment on proposed mitigation measures to reduce project delays, including alternative procurement methodologies and reprioritization. Conduct value management exercises to maintain agreed quality and scope. Monitor approval processes, resolve delays, and maintain accurate records of permits, approvals, and correspondence. Draft consultant instructions and scopes of work for consultancy procurement. Conduct and manage weekly and monthly project dashboards and reporting to leadership and relevant departments. Policy Understanding and Advocacy Stay informed about changes in regulations, policies, and strategies at regional, national, state, and Qiddiya City levels. Advocate for master plans, designs, and project approvals by presenting data and justifications to regulatory bodies and internal stakeholders. Enforce a culture of safety and quality throughout project execution. Advocate for approved processes and regulations, channeling changes and contributions through approved governance processes. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in development or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage complex development projects from planning to operation. Experience in integrating various development components such as roads, transport, and utilities. Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks and development processes. Proven ability to collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams and manage stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills for diverse teams and leadership engagement.

74920270673018f6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة يوماك إت سولووشنز عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإدارة عمليات البيع من البداية حتى التحصيل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لترويج المنتجات (السلع والخدمات) وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والعرض والتفاوض. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بالعمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على العمل في مدينة الرياض. الالتزام بتحصيل الديون ومتابعة العملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات ضمن فريق شركة يوماك إت سولووشنز في الرياض، في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة دورة المبيعات بشكل كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

74a2ee05bec86a60.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز الماس الاختصاصي لطب الاسنان عن فني تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقه في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم الرعاية التمريضية الأساسية والشخصية للمرضى، والعمل تحت إشراف ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني للممرضين وأخصائيي الرعاية الصحية الآخرين في التخطيط لرعاية المرضى وإدارة هذه الرعاية. المساعدة في إعطاء الأدوية الموصوفة والإحالة إلى أخصائيي الرعاية الصحية عند الحاجة. مساعدة المرضى في أمور النظافة الشخصية والأنشطة الأساسية مثل الاغتسال والحلاقة. المساعدة في الأنشطة اليومية مثل تناول الطعام والتمرينات، وتقديم وجبات الطعام حسب خطط الرعاية. تقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات بين الوجبات، ومساعدة المرضى في التنقل والالتفاف وتغيير الوضع. مساعدة المرضى في دخول دورات المياه وأثناء الاستحمام. تطوير المعرفة والخبرة الحفاظ على الخبرة الفنية وتحديث المعارف بشكل مستمر. دراسة المنشورات المتخصصة والمشاركة في الدورات التدريبية والمؤتمرات ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمريض أو الرعاية الصحية. القدرة على العمل تحت إشراف وتوجيه مباشر. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التمريض ضمن فريق الرعاية الصحية في مركز الماس الاختصاصي لطب الاسنان، حيث يساهم في تقديم رعاية شاملة للمرضى. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

74e9f049b9449be4.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking an OT Cyber Security Engineer Commissioning to support the commissioning, testing, integration, and handover of Operational Technology (OT) Cyber Security systems for power and energy projects. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities The role involves hands-on site activities and close collaboration with various teams and stakeholders to ensure successful commissioning and compliance with project cybersecurity requirements. Responsibilities include: Executing commissioning and site acceptance activities for OT Cyber Security systems, including configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and validation of OT security infrastructure. Performing installation and commissioning of industrial firewalls, OT switches, network segmentation/DMZ infrastructure, secure remote access solutions, SIEM/security monitoring systems, antivirus/EDR solutions, jump servers/bastion hosts, patch management, and OT asset monitoring systems. Configuring and troubleshooting industrial firewalls and security appliances, implementing and verifying firewall rules, NAT, routing, VPN, and access-control policies. Performing hardening of OT servers, workstations, engineering stations, and network devices, implementing security baselines, and supporting Windows hardening, account/password policies, USB/device control, application whitelisting, and security patches. Preparing and executing OT Cyber Security test procedures, conducting FAT/SAT, functional testing, and integrated system testing, and verifying cybersecurity controls. Configuring and validating the collection of security logs from OT assets, integrating critical OT systems with SIEM/security monitoring platforms, and supporting cybersecurity monitoring and incident investigation. Supporting OT vulnerability assessment and remediation activities, reviewing vulnerability scan results, and coordinating remediation with OEMs/system vendors. Preparing and reviewing cybersecurity documentation, including commissioning procedures, FAT/SAT reports, firewall rule matrices, network architecture diagrams, and as-built documentation. Coordinating with Project Engineering, Commissioning, SCADA/EPMS, Telecom, Networking, and Control System teams, as well as OEMs, cybersecurity solution vendors, and client/consultant teams. Key Performance Areas The engineer will be expected to complete OT cybersecurity commissioning activities according to the project schedule, achieve successful FAT/SAT and integrated testing, minimize cybersecurity-related commissioning punch points, and ensure cybersecurity compliance before system handover. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a hands-on OT Cyber Security commissioning professional with an understanding of both cybersecurity and industrial control systems, rather than solely an IT cybersecurity engineer. Practical experience in firewall configuration, OT DMZ, network segmentation, SCADA/EPMS environments, SIEM, hardening, vulnerability remediation, SAT, and client-facing commissioning is strongly preferred.

7474916cb54e6526.description: About the Role Mina Excellence is seeking an experienced IT Specialist to manage and maintain the company's IT infrastructure, enterprise applications, cloud servers, and network systems. Troubleshoot application-related issues, coordinate with external vendors, and implement system updates and configurations. 747ed71e72f0dc62.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة أكاليل للضيافة السياحي عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى مسؤول/ة إدارة المحتوى والإعلام في مدينة مكة المكرمة. تبحث الشركة عن كفاءات للانضمام إلى فريق عملها بدوام كامل، حيث يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في المجال. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل/ة هذه الوظيفة إلى إدارة وتطوير المحتوى الإعلامي للشركة، والمساهمة في تعزيز حضورها الرقمي والعلامة التجارية. يشمل ذلك التخطيط للمحتوى وتنفيذه عبر مختلف المنصات الإعلامية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المحتوى الإعلامي للشركة. إنشاء محتوى جذاب ومتنوع يتناسب مع أهداف الشركة وجمهورها المستهدف. إدارة وتحديث قنوات التواصل الاجتماعي والمواقع الإلكترونية للشركة. مراقبة وتحليل أداء المحتوى الإعلامي وتقديم التقارير الدورية. التعاون مع الأقسام الأخرى لضمان توافق المحتوى مع الحملات التسويقية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إدارة المحتوى أو الإعلام. القدرة على إنتاج محتوى إبداعي ومقنع. معرفة جيدة بمنصات التواصل الاجتماعي وأدوات إدارة المحتوى. مهارات ممتازة في الكتابة والتحرير باللغة العربية. بيئة العمل سيعمل مسؤول/ة إدارة المحتوى والإعلام ضمن فريق عمل شركة أكاليل للضيافة السياحي في مكة المكرمة، في بيئة داعمة تهدف إلى تحقيق الأهداف المشتركة وتعزيز النمو المهني. التقديم ندعو الكفاءات التي تمتلك الخبرة والمهارة في هذا المجال إلى تقديم طلباتهم للانضمام إلى فريق عملنا.

Ensure proper safeguarding of materials during all loading, unloading, and transport activities. Operate forklifts and related equipment in adherence to company and government safety standards. Handle incoming and outgoing shipments efficiently, verifying accuracy and ensuring goods are free from damage. Support warehouse and site activities by delivering and positioning materials as required for operations. Establish correct stacking and storage of materials in designated areas to ensure safety and accessibility. Provide reports and updates on material movement, forklift condition, and site activities to the Line Manager. Collaborate with warehouse, logistics, and operations teams to ensure smooth daily workflows. Conduct daily inspections and perform minor maintenance on forklifts and related equipment to ensure operational readiness. Maintain the forklift in a clean, well-kept, and fully functional condition. Ensure loading and unloading activities are completed in a timely and safe manner. Keep fleet areas, work zones, and accessories organized, clean, and free of hazards. Ensure compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements for forklift operations, including valid licenses, municipal permits, safety signals, and load capacities. Wear the company uniform neatly and maintain a professional appearance at all times. Follow all safety measures and procedures prior to performing any lifting or material handling activities. Perform any other tasks or projects assigned by the direct line manager. Monitor all lifting and material handling activities to ensure quality, safety, and accuracy. Notify the Line Manager of any defects, mistakes, errors, or safety concerns identified during operations. The travel percentage mandated for this role is as per operational requirements.

7474f905e2817f87.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث صالون رواد الاطفال للحلاقه عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة التسجيلات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ المبالغ المالية وتسجيلها في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع ضمان توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو الطرق الأخرى المعتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل بوجه رحب مع العملاء وتلبية رغباتهم بالإضافة أو الحذف على قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الصندوق المحاسبي ضمن فريق صالون رواد الاطفال للحلاقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمواعيد العمل المحددة لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

Set inventory targets across the Central Distribution Center (CDC) and branches to optimize fill rates, availability, and working capital. Govern core inventory KPIs including stock turn, first-pick fill rate, back-order ratio, aging stock, and obsolescence provisions. 742b1a369c3daaa6.description: About Jones Engineering Jones Engineering is a leading engineering services company with over 130 years of experience in high-quality, customer-focused project delivery. The company's core divisions include Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Sprinkler and Fire Protection. Additional services encompass Waste to Energy (BioEnergy), Specialist Lift, Off-Site Fabrication, Technical Support Services, Maintenance, Asset Management, BIM (Building Information Modelling), and Geo-Surveying. Jones Engineering offers competitive salaries, financial support for further training, Continuous Professional Development (CPD) leading to chartered status, and performance incentives. This full-time role, based in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, involves working with a multidisciplinary team to deliver projects. Key responsibilities include conducting technical assessments, preparing reports, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring project milestones are met. The position offers exposure to various aspects of the electrical engineering and construction sector, with support for developing knowledge towards becoming a Chartered Engineer. Key Responsibilities Manage the electrical engineering scope, reviewing IFC MEP design packages to understand project requirements, design intent, specifications, and scope of work. Lead detailed technical reviews of electrical designs to ensure compliance with project specifications, client requirements, local authority regulations (SEC, DEWA, ADDC, ADMCC), and international standards (BS, IEC, NFPA). Identify design gaps, discrepancies, constructability issues, and value engineering opportunities, proposing practical solutions. Coordinate electrical engineering with the BIM team and other disciplines to develop and issue coordinated shop drawings, single-line diagrams, and electrical layouts. Review and approve electrical shop drawings, schematics, calculations, and technical documentation for accuracy and compliance before submission. Verify electrical load schedules, cable sizing, voltage drop, short-circuit calculations, and protection coordination studies. Lead the preparation, submission, and follow-up of RFIs, technical queries, and design clarifications. Liaise with the MEP Manager, consultant, client, and other stakeholders to resolve complex technical matters and agree on design changes. Review electrical interfaces with Mechanical, CSA, Fire Protection, and BMS to ensure system coordination and constructibility. Identify and communicate potential technical, design, and program risks related to the electrical engineering scope. Ensure electrical design provisions adequately address critical infrastructure requirements. Provide engineering leadership and technical oversight for electrical installation activities, ensuring execution according to approved documentation. Offer technical direction and guidance to Construction Managers, Superintendents, supervisors, and subcontractors. Conduct regular site inspections and engineering reviews to identify installation discrepancies, quality concerns, and clashes. Ensure site teams receive the latest approved technical information and instructions, and that superseded documentation is withdrawn. Lead the resolution of site technical queries, identifying root causes and coordinating corrective actions. Review and coordinate builders' work requirements with BIM, CSA, and Construction teams. Monitor electrical installation progress against engineering deliverables and the overall construction program. Provide technical guidance on proposed design changes, equipment substitutions, and alternative installation methodologies. Identify opportunities to improve installation efficiency, constructability, system performance, reliability, and maintainability. A strong understanding of project implementation and execution within the engineering and construction sector is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. 74afd045180ad775.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني هندسة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب وصيانة النظم والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى دعم مهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب النظم والمعدات الإلكترونية، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات، ومراقبة أدائها. تحديد المخططات ونوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الهندسية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين المشاركين في تركيب النظم الإلكترونية. اختبار النظم بعد تركيبها لضمان التزامها بالمخططات والمواصفات الفنية المحددة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالمعدات الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال فني الهندسة الإلكترونية أو ما يعادله. فهم قوي للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية للنظم الإلكترونية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، وستتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع تركيب وصيانة المعدات الإلكترونية المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

749e8ce9887f7a1b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان أفضل رعاية للمرضى. المسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه، وإجراء دراسة دقيقة للحالة المرضية. تنفيذ الفحص السريري وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية حسب الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية ومدى فاعلية الخطة العلاجية المطبقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمريض وحفظها بشكل منظم ودقيق. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بمهام ومسؤوليات الدور. موقع العمل يتوفر هذا الدور في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

7455539ae055f196.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرؤيه الخضراء للانجيله الصناعيه عن مشغل آلة معالجة خيوط غزل للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشغيل ومراقبة وصيانة آلات معالجة خيوط الغزل لضمان جودة الإنتاج وسلامة العمليات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمبتدئين أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل آلات معالجة خيوط الغزل وفقاً للمواصفات المطلوبة ومراقبة أدائها بانتظام. التحقق من مطابقة المنتج للمواصفات الفنية والمعايير المحددة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية كجزء من أعمال الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات. تحديد المشكلات الفنية واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لضمان استمرارية الإنتاج. تنظيف المعدات وإجراء أعمال الصيانة الأساسية للحفاظ على كفاءتها. إعداد تقارير مفصلة بالأعطال ورفعها إلى فنيي أو تقنيي الصيانة المختصين. الاحتفاظ بسجل دقيق لجميع الأعمال المنفذة وعمليات الصيانة. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع الأوقات. تخزين المنتجات وتنفيذ إجراءات الاختبار للتأكد من أن الأجهزة تعمل على النحو الأمثل أثناء الإنتاج. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في تشغيل آلات معالجة خيوط الغزل أو مجال صناعي مشابه. القدرة على فهم واتباع المواصفات الفنية وإجراءات التشغيل. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في بيئة العمل. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات جيدة في الملاحظة لتحديد المشكلات المحتملة في الآلات. القدرة على أداء مهام الصيانة الأساسية والتنظيف. مهارات تواصل فعالة لإعداد التقارير والتنسيق مع فريق الصيانة. الالتزام بالدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل لضمان جودة الإنتاج. بيئة العمل يعمل مشغل آلة معالجة خيوط الغزل في بيئة صناعية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الدور يتطلب العمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تحقيق أهداف الإنتاج مع الالتزام الصارم بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

7491df69ca90efa0.description: About Leading the Way Solutions Leading the Way Solutions is a Saudi Arabia-based company that provides integrated project support services. These services encompass interior fit-out, civil works, manpower solutions, logistics, transportation, and warehousing. The company also supplies construction materials, PPE and HSE supplies, solar panel solutions, and scaffolding supply and installation. Assist with mixing and applying paints, coatings, and finishes according to project specifications. Mask and protect surrounding areas to prevent paint splatter or damage. 746d10f4defbaf4d.description: About the Role Almarai is seeking a Trade Marketing Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on driving sales, profit, and space growth for all Almarai product groups across the GCC region. The supervisor will coordinate national and regional product promotions and develop effective category and product planograms, applying the latest category management principles to increase overall sales and profit for the company. Key Responsibilities The Trade Marketing Supervisor will be responsible for both promotional and merchandising activities: Develop and manage GCC-wide promotional plans and annual calendars. Oversee the execution of promotions across all regions, ensuring alignment with key accounts. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketing, sales, supply chain, and finance to deliver effective promotions. Monitor performance and present monthly reports on promotional impact. Create and maintain merchandising plans, schedules, and planograms for GCC markets. Coordinate new product development (NPD) listings, sponsorships, and events with relevant teams. Ensure merchandising excellence through collaboration with divisions and key accounts. Coach sales teams to improve execution and optimize stock, distribution, and waste control. Analyze and report monthly on merchandising effectiveness. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this position should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. The role requires a professional who can coordinate complex activities and collaborate effectively across various departments. 74cef05f70269b25.description: About the Role Bechtel Corporation is seeking a Planning Manager to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves leading planning activities for assigned projects, identifying schedule trends, and providing innovative solutions to scheduling challenges. The Planning Manager will ensure timely schedule updates and manage all reporting requirements, playing a crucial role in project success and scheduling efficiency. Project Context: Expo 2030 Riyadh The Expo 2030 Riyadh is a global platform focused on sustainable development, innovation, and transformative thinking, under the theme “Foresight for Tomorrow.” Scheduled from October 2030 to March 2031, the event anticipates over 40 million visits. Bechtel will manage the infrastructure program for the 6 km2 Masterplan, which includes early works, utilities, and public spaces. This site will transition into a mixed-use legacy development post-event, leveraging international sustainability standards for urban afforestation, treated water, and energy sources. Key Responsibilities Prepare detailed staffing plans for planning and scheduling activities. Review design scope criteria and quantities, performing in-depth analysis to identify project schedule impacts. Develop additional estimating bases when information is incomplete and recommend action plans to mitigate schedule risks and gaps. Contribute to the maintenance, improvement, integration, and major updates of the Client Project Development and Execution main schedule. Organize the work scope for all workstreams into the total project plan and conduct regular reviews of project scope in schedules, including establishing conceptual scope for schedule studies. Establish milestones for the total project or major portions and ensure project work activities support these milestones. Organize the timely, systematic, and complete acquisition of scope definition and related data. Review performing organizations' work logics to ensure schedules adequately support the overall project schedule. Plan, organize, and establish appropriate quantification levels for objectives and scope definition, designating reference jobs for source data and quantity reconciliations. Supervise schedule resource loading and leveling, and organize the development of bulk commodity release and installation curves. Integrate appropriate workforce requirements for each discipline/specialty relative to overall project needs. Engage with other Clusters and Stakeholders to manage key interfaces and ensure their incorporation into the project schedule. Obtain required schedule information from all disciplines, identify schedule restraints, and ensure understanding of total project schedule needs across departments. Ensure total integration of schedule activities and identify schedule considerations and problems from interdisciplinary or group restraints and interfaces. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in planning and scheduling activities. Demonstrated leadership in managing planning teams and activities. Strong analytical skills to identify schedule trends and develop innovative solutions. Proficiency in managing schedule updates and reporting requirements. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

74f3dd274de34823.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاخوين عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. يمثل هذا الدور فرصة للمحاسبين الطموحين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة للانضمام إلى بيئة عمل ديناميكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد التقارير المالية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية قوية لتدقيق الحسابات والبيانات المالية. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع المهام المحاسبية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة الوثائق والسجلات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات المحاسبية للشركة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمزيد من التفاصيل.

74f6ec4932bcd6e5.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Back of House (Reporting to the Sous Chef) Compensation: 8,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are partnering with a highly regarded, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. You will serve as both a technical anchor and an emerging leader—overseeing preparation, maintaining rigorous standards, and stepping up to run the line when the team needs you most. Organization & Adaptability: Manage inventory control, stock rotation, and kitchen flow, seamlessly adjusting to the shifting demands of busy services.

All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from how we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally. 8+ years of account management experience in ICT, cloud services, or technology-related industries. Experience managing Enterprise or enterprise customer accounts Good understanding of ICT solutions including Cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Cybersecurity, Data and analytics, and Digital transformation solutions Proven ability to drive account growth through upselling and cross-selling Experience working with major ICT and cloud platforms such as Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or similar. Knowledge of cybersecurity, data management, networking, and digital transformation best practices. Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce). 740f2ca7a9fa4ccf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مصادر الانشاء للمقاولات عن مهندس كهروميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الخرج. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إدارة عمليات الصيانة الكهروميكانيكية والإشراف على أداء فريق الصيانة لضمان كفاءة تشغيل المعدات والأنظمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة عمليات الصيانة الكهروميكانيكية وتوزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة. متابعة أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. إعداد وتنفيذ برامج التشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية وأنظمة التحكم الميكانيكية. الالتزام بتوصيات الشركة المصنعة ومواصفات الصيانة عند تطبيق البرامج. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهروميكانيكية. متابعة والإشراف على إجراءات الإصلاح والمعالجة للأعطال المكتشفة. إعداد الوثائق والجداول الزمنية والتقارير المختصة بنتائج الدراسات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. مراجعة وتقييم وتطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل لمواكبة التطورات التقنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهروميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم عميق لمبادئ الصيانة الكهروميكانيكية والتشغيل الوقائي. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال ووضع خطط الإصلاح الفعالة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية لإدارة فرق الصيانة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات التقنية وتطبيقها في بيئة العمل. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع فريق العمل والجهات الأخرى. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مؤسسة مصادر الانشاء للمقاولات، ومقرها في الرياض، مع التركيز على العمل في الخرج. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة ديناميكية تركز على الكفاءة والجودة في الصيانة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

74108fecfb0d44b5.description: About the Role Aqarat Real Estate Development Company is seeking an Accountant to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for the accurate recording of daily financial transactions and the comprehensive management of financial records, ensuring integrity and compliance. Role Summary The Accountant will manage receipts, payments, expenses, and payroll, playing a critical role in maintaining the financial health and transparency of the company. This position involves executing bank transfers, preparing essential accounting entries, and conducting reconciliations to resolve discrepancies. Key Responsibilities Accurately record all daily financial transactions. Process and record receipts and payments on a daily basis. Record daily expenses and prepare payroll statements. Execute bank transfers and monitor banking operations. Prepare monthly accounting entries and closing entries. Maintain secure, organized, and accessible financial records. Ensure the accuracy and integrity of all accounting entries. Conduct periodic reconciliations of customer, bank, and supplier balances to identify and resolve discrepancies. Proficiency in managing financial records and performing reconciliations. 746f8ad0a32c9e3c.description: About * Renal Care Saudi Arabia * Renal Care Saudi Arabia is a leader in the dialysis industry, committed to recruiting top talent and fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. The organization values the differences within its workforce and strives to maintain a supportive culture at all levels. The Role of Resident Nephrologist This full-time position for a Resident Nephrologist is based in Makkah, with operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role is responsible for providing quality patient care, clinical leadership, and oversight of clinical teammate care delivery, focusing on the day-to-day management of patients undergoing end-stage renal disease (ESRD) treatment. Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Participate in daily bedside management rounds under the supervision of a Specialist Physician Nephrology or Consultant Nephrologist. Assume an active role in on-call duty rotations within the center. Admit patients referred from other hospital facilities after consultation with the responsible physician. Evaluate new admissions and coordinate investigation plans with attending physicians and nursing staff to establish diagnoses and management courses. Document patient plans in charts and maintain updated follow-up notes. Supervise the clinical team in their duties and responsibilities and actively participate in unit rounds. Execute required diagnostic procedures on patients and guide the clinical team when feasible. Encourage and support staff in acquiring specialized procedure skills under senior supervision. Participate in medical care delivery for in-center or home therapy services, preferably arranging follow-up for discharged patients. Contribute to developing discharge and death summaries and other patient-related reports. Participate in departmental educational and training activities, including rounds, tutorials, and journal clubs. Guide the clinical team on company policies and procedures. Comply with standards established by Approved International Accreditation Standards. Identify and report occurrences inconsistent with center operations or service standards, including actions by employees or visitors and situations posing risk to patients, staff, or visitors. Perform patient assessments, including vital signs and other parameters, review dialysis orders, determine physical and mental condition, assist in assessing dietary or medication regimen compliance, and document observations. Provide chronic hemodialysis therapy and formulate dialysis plans through various accesses, observing all safety measures for ESRD patients. Administer treatments according to Consultant orders and document them regularly. Perform data analysis, assess and monitor patient laboratory investigations, and act on relevant changes or abnormalities. Deliver high-quality patient care with consideration and respect. Ensure implementation and compliance with USRC policies, procedures, and all safety regulatory requirements. Ensure the clinic is prepared for emergency patient care, including teammate training, equipment readiness, and established procedures. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within their knowledge, skills, and abilities. Qualifications and Requirements Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Medicine and Surgery or an equivalent certificate. Certification: Qualified and classified by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties as a Nephrology or Internal Medicine Resident. Experience: 5-10 years of relevant experience. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position located in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with operations also in Jeddah. The salary for this role will be disclosed during the hiring process.

74827069d17d63d2.description: About KBR Saudi Arabia KBR Saudi Arabia is a company focused on innovation and collaboration, committed to improving the world responsibly and safely. The organization attracts a diverse workforce and leverages creativity and resourcefulness to deliver expertise. Role Overview: Instrument Technician I KBR Saudi Arabia is seeking an Instrument Technician I to join its team in Al Jubail. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the reliability and availability of instrument assets, which are essential for maintaining the operation of Process Units. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead, supervise, and coordinate the activities of the maintenance technician team, ensuring compliance with preventive maintenance plans and efficient execution of breakdown maintenance on Instrument systems, equipment, and facilities. Execute monthly and weekly maintenance plans. Control and submit regular progress reports on maintenance activities. Provide onsite maintenance and repairs for various types of instruments, including generators, transformers, and motors. Ensure all maintenance activities adhere to established standards, specifications, safety procedures, manufacturer’s recommendations, and contract terms. 740e3b43bb1162b2.description: We are hiring a Head of Investor Relations to lead the team that runs our investor network. Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put break-out founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and our team runs the investor relations work around every introduction. We are paid by the founder for our work, never by the round. Investors are members of the network and pay nothing. We are a small, senior team, profitable and self-funded. The role This is a leadership seat. You run the IR team: around six direct reports, the associates who each hold a book of members and clients. You report directly to the two co-founders. Your job is to make that team excellent. You hire well, set a clear bar, run the weekly rhythm, coach every associate on their calls and pitches, and have the hard conversation early when someone is off track. The team’s results are your results. Founders work with us for our investor network. Members read what we send because it fits what they told us. Through your team, you own that network and keep every relationship getting stronger month after month. You still take the mandate calls with our most senior family offices, because a leader who stays close to the work coaches it better. What you will own The IR team: around six direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, weekly 1:1s, coaching, performance, and a clear bar for what good looks like. The team’s rhythm: a weekly kickoff, a weekly review of every win and loss, and a team that runs on its own when you are not in the room. The health of the investor network: more active members every month, and every member getting deals that fit their thesis at the pace they asked for. Pitch quality: every introduction your team sends is one you would put your own name on. A weekly read on the numbers to the co-founders: mandate calls, activations, pitches, founder calls and referrals. Senior mandate calls with family offices and strategic investors, including new regions. Close work with our client success team, so every client’s raise keeps moving. You are a fit if you Have run a team before, ideally around six direct reports, and can show what they achieved under you and who you grew. Have hired, coached and, when needed, let go of people, and held a team to a standard without doing their work for them. Have 6 or more years on the investment side of a family office, VC or growth fund, or in capital raising for private companies. Hold real, current relationships with family offices, and know what they ask before they take a founder call. Write a two-line pitch an investor reads to the end. Run on systems: CRM discipline, a clear weekly rhythm, nothing left in your head. Treat discretion as a reflex: founders’ numbers and members’ names stay confidential. Work like it is 2026: AI tooling runs the admin so your hours go to people. What we offer US$200K to US$300K total compensation. Fully remote, with a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time. A seat reporting directly to both co-founders, a team to lead, and a network that grows with every month you put into it. How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to a short application form. We read every application. Please do not name investors or companies from past roles anywhere in it.
